title: A facade from reusable parts.
summary: Compose pilasters, window frames, sills and floor bands from shared profiles and primitive prototypes.
prompt: In Polynite, build an editable operator study: Compose pilasters, window frames, sills and floor bands from shared profiles and primitive prototypes. Use the supplied JSON as a starting point, then invent a different composition. Declare reusable geometry prototypes and reference them with instance nodes. Keep profiles, layout, material roles and dimensions editable. Inspect actual instancing counters and rendered results; preserve the current scene.
try: Choose a variant, then change a parameter in Adjust.
Edit the prototype to update its copies; keep individual exceptions when needed.
Save the scene and reopen it; geometry definitions remain included.
steps: Define a reusable shape from a primitive, profile or sweep.
Place instances with parameterized transforms and bounded repetition.
Assign shared materials; inspect geometry, save and compare the result.
settings: Open & test > Variant and Adjust. In Polynite: Scene settings > Living architecture > study. Read scene.cinematic status.instancing to inspect actual CPU/GPU sharing.
limits: Editable operator study. Mesh prototypes are shared; nested prefab graphs and Boolean openings are not implemented. Compatible groups of four or more use GPU instancing at full detail; unsupported cases use regular rendering. Performance depends on scene and device.
